entry.title: Quantum State Classification Using QNN
entry.content:
Quantum State Classification Using QNN

This project implements parameterised quantum circuits (PQCs) and quantum neural networks for entanglement and separability classification of multi-qubit quantum states. Developed in collaboration with Thirumalai and Diksha Sharma.

View Repository on GitHub

📌 Key Highlights

  • Variational Architectures: Designs and tests ansatz structures optimized for state classification tasks.
  • Entanglement Detection: High-accuracy boundary identification distinguishing entangled from separable state geometries.
  • Noise Resilience: Evaluated under depolarizing and amplitude damping noise channels on simulated backends.

entry.title: Quantum Computing Lab Notebooks
entry.content:
Quantum Computing Lab Notebooks

Comprehensive, open-access laboratory notebooks designed for students and researchers exploring fundamental and intermediate quantum computation, circuit composition, quantum algorithms, and introductory quantum machine learning.

View Repository on GitHub

📌 Covered Topics

  • Quantum Fundamentals: Superposition, entanglement, Bell state verification, and quantum teleportation.
  • Quantum Algorithms: Deutsch-Jozsa, Grover search algorithm, and Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE).
  • Quantum Machine Learning: Quantum feature encoding, parameterised circuits, and variational state classification.
